caption: The drawing features a long, black dress displayed prominently in the center, rendered in solid black with shading to suggest folds and texture. The dress has long sleeves, a high waistline with decorative trim, structured shoulders with additional textured or ruffled detailing at the tops of the sleeves, and a pointed collar. The front of the dress is separated by a vertical seam or closure running down the center. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a smaller, lightly sketched outline of the dress from the back, showing a gathered section below the collar and the long sleeves, but without the detailed coloring. The background is plain and light in color, with some faint discoloration near the edges. In the lower right corner, the name "Margaret Concha" is written in small, neat script.
title: Woman's Coat
